package soak

// PLANT: a temp file created and never removed, per request.
// Expected: oracle (b) temp_files FAIL listing soak-plant-* names.

import (
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

func init() {
	handlerWrappers = append(handlerWrappers, func(next http.Handler, _ *soakEnv) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if f, err := os.CreateTemp("", "soak-plant-*"); err == nil {
				_ = f.Close()
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	})
}
